description: This file defines API routes for a branding compliance backend service, handling job creation, deletion, asset upload, analysis triggering, status retrieval, and asset/result serving. It uses FastAPI framework components, models for jobs and assets, and service classes for analysis, fixing, reporting, and state management. The routes support multipart uploads, zip extraction, background analysis tasks, and result downloads, with detailed validation and error handling.

classes.name: CreateJobRequest
classes.description: Request model for creating a new job with optional owner, title, description.

classes.name: CreateJobResponse
classes.description: Response model containing the created job ID.

classes.name: StatusResponse
classes.description: Model representing job status and progress details.

classes.name: FixAssetRequest
classes.description: Request structure to fix a specific asset.

classes.name: BatchFixRequest
classes.description: Request structure for batch fixes across multiple assets.

methods.name: create_job(data: CreateJobRequest, state: StateStore = Depends(get_state_store))
methods.description: Endpoint to create a new job; generates UUID, validates, creates workspace, stores job.

methods.name: delete_job(job_id: str, state: StateStore = Depends(get_state_store))
methods.description: Deletes a job and its workspace directory.

methods.name: upload_assets_zip(job_id: str, file: UploadFile = File(...), state: StateStore = Depends(get_state_store))
methods.description: Uploads a zip of assets, extracts into workspace uploads directory.

methods.name: upload_assets_multipart( job_id: str, request: Request, images: List[UploadFile] = File(default_factory=list, description="One or more input assets (images/docs)"), old_logo: UploadFile | None = File(default=None, description="Old brand/logo image"), new_logo: UploadFile | None = File(default=None, description="New brand/logo image"), state: StateStore = Depends(get_state_store), )
methods.description: Handles multipart uploads of assets and logos, saves files, updates job status.

methods.name: upload_old_brand(job_id: str, file: UploadFile = File(...), state: StateStore = Depends(get_state_store))
methods.description: Uploads an old brand reference image.

methods.name: upload_new_brand(job_id: str, file: UploadFile = File(...), state: StateStore = Depends(get_state_store))
methods.description: Uploads a new brand reference image.

methods.name: analyze_job(job_id: str, background: BackgroundTasks, request: Request, state: StateStore = Depends(get_state_store))
methods.description: Triggers background analysis tasks, manages job state, checks inputs and status.

methods.name: get_status(job_id: str, state: StateStore = Depends(get_state_store))
methods.description: Returns current job processing status and progress.

methods.name: get_results(job_id: str, state: StateStore = Depends(get_state_store))
methods.description: Provides assets and issues information for a job.

methods.name: get_asset_preview( job_id: str, asset_id: str, view: Literal["original", "overlay", "fixed"] = Query("original", description="Preview type"), page: int | None = Query(default=None, description="0-based page index (PDF only)"), state: StateStore = Depends(get_state_store), )
methods.description: Serves preview files for assets, considering requested view and page.

methods.name: fix_single_asset(job_id: str, asset_id: str, req: FixAssetRequest, request: Request, state: StateStore = Depends(get_state_store))
methods.description: Applies an automatic fix to a specific asset.

methods.name: batch_fix(job_id: str, req: BatchFixRequest, request: Request, state: StateStore = Depends(get_state_store))
methods.description: Runs automatic fixes over all assets with issues.

methods.name: download_artifacts( job_id: str, type: Literal["zip", "report", "both"] = Query("zip", description="Artifact type to download"), state: StateStore = Depends(get_state_store), )
methods.description: Prepares and serves download files for reports or zipped outputs.
